title_protection.quote: Any person, partnership, association or corporation, or any partner, director, officer, agent or member thereof who shall engage in the business of pawnbroking in this Commonwealth without first obtaining a license under this act, shall be guilty of a misdemeanor

disciplinary_grounds.description: Pawnbroker violates any provision of this act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: revoke any license if the pawnbroker shall violate any provision of this act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Pawnbroker violates any rule or regulation made by the Secretary of Banking
disciplinary_grounds.quote: if the pawnbroker shall violate any rule or regulation made by the Secretary of Banking under and within the authority of this act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Pawnbroker fails to comply with any demand, rule or regulation lawfully made by the Secretary of Banking
disciplinary_grounds.quote: if a pawnbroker shall fail to comply with any demand, rule or regulation lawfully made by the Secretary of Banking under and within the authority of this act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Pawnbroker fails to pay the cost of examination by the Secretary of Banking
disciplinary_grounds.quote: if the pawnbroker shall fail to pay the cost of examination by the Secretary of Banking or his authorized representative

disciplinary_grounds.description: Pawnbroker fails to maintain the required bond
disciplinary_grounds.quote: if the pawnbroker has failed to maintain in effect the bond required under the provisions of this act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Pawnbroker fails to file the annual report to the Secretary of Banking within the stipulated time
disciplinary_grounds.quote: if the pawnbroker shall fail to file the annual report to the Secretary of Banking within the time stipulated in this act

disciplinary_grounds.description: A fact or condition exists which would have warranted refusing to issue the license originally
disciplinary_grounds.quote: if any fact or condition exists which, if it had existed at the time of original application for such license, clearly would have warranted the Secretary of Banking originally in refusing to issue such license

bonding_required.quote: A bond in the penal sum of two thousand ($2,000.00) dollars shall accompany every application for license.

insurance_required.quote: The Secretary of Banking may require a pawnbroker to carry adequate insurance on pledges if the financial responsibility of the pawnbroker does not assure adequate protection to the pledger.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: A pawnbroker shall not be authorized to engage in business unless he shall have obtained a license from the municipality, if the municipality requires such a license to be obtained.

definition_quote.value: "Pawnbroker" includes any person, who--(1) engages in the business of lending money on the deposit or pledge of personal property, other than choses in action, securities, or written evidences of indebtedness; or (2) purchases personal property with an expressed or implied agreement or understanding to sell it back at a subsequent time at a stipulated price; or (3) lends money upon goods, wares or merchandise pledged, stored or deposited as collateral security.

surety_bond_required.quote: A bond in the penal sum of two thousand ($2,000.00) dollars shall accompany every application for license. The bond shall be executed by a surety company authorized by the laws of Pennsylvania to transact business within this Commonwealth.

surety_bond_amount_usd.quote: A bond in the penal sum of two thousand ($2,000.00) dollars shall accompany every application for license.

bond_per_location.quote: A separate bond shall be required for each place of business conducted by a pawnbroker.

max_interest_rate_annual_pct.quote: A pawnbroker shall not charge, contract for or receive interest in excess of six per cent (6%) per year on any loan.

max_service_fee_monthly_pct.value: 2.5% per month on unpaid principal balance
max_service_fee_monthly_pct.quote: Not more than two and one-half per cent (2 1/2%) per month on that part of the unpaid principal balance of any loan

installment_loans_prohibited.quote: A loan granted under the provisions of this act shall not be repayable in installments.

minimum_pledge_hold_hours.quote: A pledge taken as security on a loan granted under the provisions of this act may be retained by the pawnbroker until a period of forty-eight (48) hours has elapsed since such pledge was received by the pawnbroker.

pawn_ticket_required.quote: At the time of granting a loan and upon the subsequent renewal of any loan, the pawnbroker shall furnish to the pledger a pawn ticket which is serially numbered

value: name and address of the pawnbroker
name and address of the pledger
name and address of disclosed principal, if any
total amount of principal, interest and charges required to redeem the pledge on the due date
statement that the pledge may be sold after ninety (90) days of the due date of the loan if not redeemed
pawn_ticket_required_fields.quote: the pawnbroker shall furnish to the pledger a pawn ticket which is serially numbered and which shall contain the following information--name and address of the pawnbroker, the name and address of the pledger, name and address of disclosed principal, if any, the date of the loan, the amount actually loaned, the serial number of the loan, description of the pledge, due date of the loan, the total amount of principal, interest and charges required to redeem the pledge on the due date, a statement setting forth that the pledge may be sold after ninety (90) days of the due date of the loan if not redeemed

pledger_identity_verification_required.quote: At the time of granting an original loan, the pawnbroker shall enter upon his records, in the form and manner designated by the Secretary of Banking, a description of the pledger so as to identify the pledger, including the pledger's name and address, and either the pledger's motor vehicle operator's number, the pledger's Social Security number, or, if the pledger does not have this information, such other proof of identity as the Secretary of Banking shall provide by regulation.

records_retention_period_years.quote: The records of a pawnbroker shall be retained for a period of two years after the date of the payment of any loan, or in case the loan is not paid, the records of a pawnbroker shall be retained for a period of two (2) years after the date of the sale of the pledge.

annual_report_due_date.quote: Every pawnbroker licensed under this act shall annually, on or before the first day of March, file a report with the Secretary of Banking

minimum_pledger_age.quote: A pawnbroker shall not accept a pledge from any person under the age of eighteen years.

sunday_business_prohibited.quote: A pawnbroker shall not transact any business on Sunday

restricted_business_hours.value: No pledges accepted between 9:00 PM and 7:00 AM on days other than Sunday
restricted_business_hours.quote: nor shall he accept a pledge on any other day between the hours of nine o'clock in the evening and seven o'clock in the morning, unless further restricted by municipal ordinance

unredeemed_pledge_min_hold_days_before_s.quote: No unredeemed pledge may be sold before the expiration of ninety (90) days after the due date of the loan unless otherwise specifically authorized in writing by the pledger.

presale_notice_required.quote: A pawnbroker shall not sell any pledge where the loan is seven dollars ($7) or more unless due notice of such contemplated sale has been forwarded to the pledger by mail

presale_notice_days.quote: Notice of the contemplated sale of a pledge shall be mailed to the pledger not less than thirty (30) days prior to the date of sale.

surplus_reversion_period_years.quote: If a surplus remaining from the sale of a pledge is not paid or claimed within one year from the date of sale, such surplus shall revert to the pawnbroker.

public_hearing_required_for_initial_lice.quote: A public hearing shall be held upon initial application for a pawnbroker's license.

neighbor_notice_radius_feet.quote: The Secretary of Banking shall permit residents residing within a radius of five hundred (500) feet of the proposed location to testify at the hearing.

license_nontransferable.quote: Such license may not be transferred or assigned.

one_license_per_location.quote: Not more than one place of business may be operated under the same license.

municipal_license_also_required.quote: A pawnbroker shall not be authorized to engage in business unless he shall have obtained a license from the municipality, if the municipality requires such a license to be obtained.

stolen_property_reporting_required.quote: Such property and a copy of the seizure receipt shall be delivered immediately by the pawnbroker to the police authorities.

compliance_as_defense_to_receiving_stole.quote: Whenever any pawnbroker shall make a complete and accurate report to the local police authorities, and shall comply with this act, and such regulations of the Secretary of Banking as may hereafter be adopted pursuant thereto, such conduct on the part of the pawnbroker shall be evidence of the innocence of such pawnbroker of any crime of receiving stolen goods, notwithstanding the fact that the articles may, in fact, be stolen
